flex_tests.description: FLEX droplet tests (PSI-69). One row = one droplet ignition. Raw PSI values kept in *_raw columns.
flex_tests.source: PSI-69 experiment table + per-test TestSheet files + NASA/TP-2015-216046

test: Row number in the PSI table ('FLEX Test #'). Not the official FLEX number after test 155.
flex_number: Official FLEX test number assigned via CIR identifier from NASA/TP-2015-216046.
table_number_offset: flex_number minus PSI table number (0 for 155 rows; 1-6 after row 155).
cir_id: Combustion Integrated Rack test identifier (e.g. 181F001). Reliable join key.
x_o2: Initial ambient O2 mole fraction (0-1). Not a percentage.
pO2_kPa: O2 partial pressure = x_o2 x p_kPa (derived).
diluent: Dominant inert (N2, CO2 or He) derived from mole fractions.
dext_mm: Droplet diameter at visible flame extinction.
K_mm2s: Average burning-rate constant (PSI column labelled 'Burning rate; mm').
K_fit_mm2s: K refitted by AeroFox: OLS of d^2 vs t on 0.2-0.9 of burn time from the raw DropletData file.
K_fit_r2: Coefficient of determination of that fit.
K_post_mm2s: Regression rate of d^2 after visible extinction (if >=10 samples).

flex_droplet_fits.description: One row per FLEX DropletData file: AeroFox fits of the d^2-law.

flex_number: Official FLEX number from file name.
K_fit_se: Standard error of the fitted slope.

flex035_timeseries.description: FLEX-035 droplet history with UV-camera (LLUV) signal.

lluv: LLUV camera flame signal (sparser than diameter).

saffire_samples.description: Saffire I, II, III burned samples.
saffire_samples.source: PSI-98, PSI-99, PSI-100 tables; NTRS 20170008805 for filled values

material_source: Where the material name came from (psi_table or NTRS).
o2_pct: O2 concentration; Saffire-II values derived from CO2 production.

saffire2_flow.description: Measured duct flow per Saffire-II sample from the telemetry workbook.

ignition_t_s: Time of first igniter activity, mission-relative.
anem1_mean_cm_s: Mean anemometer 1 reading over 0-120 s after ignition.

bass2_tests.description: BASS-II test points in the Microgravity Science Glovebox.

flag_o2_increase: Final O2 exceeds initial by >1 vol% (implausible).

same_reduced.description: SAME and SAME-R smoke particle statistics per test.

net_aging_s: Time smoke was held before measurement.

same_r_detectors.source: PSI-101 results workbook, 'SAME R Results' sheet

iss_scatter_V: ISS smoke detector scatter channel; ~50% of tests at 6.2-6.3 V (apparent range limit).

catalog_files: Entries in the PSI file catalog.
